dedupe_keys.name: areas com suscetibilidade a movimentos de massa no vale do taquari

description: Áreas com suscetibilidade a movimentos de massa no Vale do Taquari is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Áreas com suscetibilidade a movimentos de massa são regiões que apresentam maior risco de ocorrer deslizamentos, escorregamentos, tombamentos de rocha, queda de blocos, corrida de materiais, espraiamento. A identificação dessas áreas é crucial para a prevenção de desastres, permitindo a implementação de medidas de mitigação e planejamento urbano adequado. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, Vale do Taquari, Planos Diretores, Arroio do Meio, Colinas. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
